primary_users: Android/AI engineer evaluating candidate local LLMs on a target device
Android developer integrating the Harnex shared runtime into an application
primary_jobs: compare candidate models and inference configurations for a concrete use case and device
install, select and run a local model while inspecting evidence-backed performance, health and diagnostics
inspect consumer applications, assigned use cases and effective inference presets, then configure them without relying on internal binding or transport concepts
validate shared-runtime integration without silent cloud fallback

accessibility.target: Android platform accessibility with WCAG 2.2 AA-equivalent contrast and semantics

critical_journeys.name: Import or download a GGUF, install it, explicitly select it and reconcile residency state
Select a usable model, submit a prompt, stream generation, cancel or complete, and inspect terminal metrics
Open a consumer application, inspect its assigned use cases, select or create an inference preset, persist the default assignment and verify the effective configuration after restart
Inspect source-backed diagnostics and export a privacy-safe evidence snapshot
Run an explicit physical-device validation flow and preserve evidence identity without overstating emulator results

validation.accessibility_automation: ui/design-system contrast and touch-target JVM tests, Compose semantics coverage and Android Lint
validation.visual_regression: code-owned Compose previews and scoped screenshot evidence where the owning UX specification requires it; no blanket golden suite is claimed
validation.manual_accessibility: representative-device TalkBack, dynamic-text, focus, portrait/landscape and low-motion acceptance before release claims
validation.usability_evidence: task-based physical-device acceptance for primary model, generation, consumer-configuration and diagnostics flows; no formal representative-user study is claimed
